tool.name: Beacon2 Datasets
tool.description: retrieve datasets from federated beacons or a self-hosted database
tool.command: #if str($connection.transport) == "api" #set $filters = $connection.filters beacon2-query entity --entity dataset @PROVIDER_ARGS@ --granularity '$connection.granularity' --limit $connection.pagination.limit --skip $connection.pagination.skip #if str($connection.pagination.sample) --sample $connection.pagination.sample #end if #if str($connection.lookup.mode) == "by_id" --entity-id '$connection.lookup.entity_id' #end if @FILTER_ARGS@ @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #else beacon2-query entity --entity dataset --transport mongodb --db-host '$connection.db_host' --db-port $connection.db_port --database '$connection.database' --collection '$connection.collection' --credentials-file '$credentials' #if str($connection.mongo_fields.dataUseConditions) --field 'dataUseConditions.duoDataUse.label=$connection.mongo_fields.dataUseConditions' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.ontologyModifiers) --field 'dataUseConditions.duoDataUse.modifiers.label=$connection.mongo_fields.ontologyModifiers' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.identification) --entity-id '$connection.mongo_fields.identification' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.name) --field 'name=$connection.mongo_fields.name' #end if @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #end if

param.name: entity_id
param.label: Identifier
param.help: As used by that beacon. Identifiers are local to each beacon.

section.name: mongo_fields
section.title: Fields to match (each one exact; all must match)

param.name: dataUseConditions
param.label: DATAUSECONDITIONS
param.help: Data use conditions applying to this dataset, e.g. disease specific research Matched exactly against dataUseConditions.duoDataUse.label.

param.name: ontologyModifiers
param.label: DATA USE CONDITIONS MODIFIERS
param.help: Modifiers that further specify the datasets, e.g. coronary artery disease Matched exactly against dataUseConditions.duoDataUse.modifiers.label.

param.name: name
param.label: NAME
param.help: Name of the dataset Matched exactly against name.

tool.help:
**What it does**
@HELP_READS@
Retrieves dataset records from the beacons you select, or from a self-hosted Beacon MongoDB database.
**Two ways to narrow a query, one per connection**
On the *Beacon v2 API* the tool takes **filters**: ontology terms such as ``NCIT:C3058``, which each beacon maps onto its own records. The API has no way to match a field's value directly.
On a *self-hosted MongoDB* the tool takes **fields**: the same named fields the 2.2.x tools offered, each matched exactly against a document path shown in its help. A raw collection has no mapping from ontology terms to fields, so filters are not offered there.
@HELP_OUTPUTS@
